title: A plain memories listing answers in the project-memory state drift in which master answered
outcome: A plain memories listing answers in the project-memory state drift in which master answered
acceptance: In a store whose project_memory_state row for the project is missing while project memories exist, `engram work memories` and `engram work memories QUERY` without a context generation return their rows and record nothing, as before the memory-recovery direction landed; only the first unfiltered page that carries a context generation reads the memory position it records; a test lists memories in that drift state.

completion.summary: A plain memories listing, a search and an --after page answer from the memory rows alone again while the project's recorded memory position is missing (the drift a projection repair rebuilds), as master did before the memory-recovery direction. Only the first unfiltered page carrying a context generation reads the position it records; there, a missing position leaves the listing delivered and unrecorded. Storage and word tests cover the drift state. Landed 16f07ce, full gate test-ac1440cf 9/9, round 1 clean, independent evaluation passed.
